public.text: Client, facility, workforce, and product registries are described as metadata registries. These registries contain authoritative entity data, not only metadata. Applying “metadata registry” to all of them may be conceptually misleading.
public.suggestedRevision: Use core authoritative registries and semantic artefact repositories as the broader category. Reserve “metadata registry” for catalogues or registries whose primary content is metadata.
